name: CasCioppo's Hot Sausage
tagline: Seattle's famous handmade spicy Italian sausage
description: A Seattle landmark since 1947, CasCioppo's famous Italian sausage has been our house sausage for over 40 years. Made with garlic, spices, and red pepper, this hot sausage is perfect for grilling, lasagna, meat sauce, pizza, or any other place when you want things to taste better. Cook to temperature with or without the casing and enjoy. Apx 5 to 6 links to a pound.

name: CasCioppo's Mild Sausage
tagline: Seattle's famous handmade sweet Italian sausage
description: A Seattle landmark since 1947, CasCioppo's famous Italian sausage has been our house sausage for over 40 years. Made with garlic and a blend of spices, this sweet sausage is perfect for grilling, lasagna, meat sauce, pizza, or any other place when you want things to taste better. Cook to temperature with or without the casing and enjoy. Apx 5 to 6 links to a pound.

name: DeLaurenti Housemade Meatballs
description:
Ok, these are the real deal - created and produced in the comfort of our kitchen upstairs at the store. Approximately 6 meatballs per pound, FULLY COOKED and ready to go! Your only job is choosing the number of meatballs & deciding whether you want them lightly covered in sauce or plain. Want more than twelve? Just choose the number, a quantity & multiply it! Ie: 12 meatballs, qty of 2 = 24 meatballs! Want them swimming in sauce instead of just covered? Order more DeLaurenti Marinara to go with it!

As an ode to Nate's Nonna, we love to serve 3 meatballs in a bowl with red sauce, Reggiano & a piece of grilled bread. This was the only thing that would keep him and his cousins from tearing the house apart. They lined up and were dispensed a sampler meatball in sauce and a piece of bread for dipping. Receiving it was committing to good behavior. They are great served as such, piled into a soft roll, or, of course combined with some marinara & tossed with spaghetti! If you would like, we include enough sauce to cover. You might want to order another container of marinara!

name: Olympia Provisions Frankfurter, 4pk footlongers
tagline: Old School Frankfurter that hangs out of the bun!
description: Heralded as the best hot dog in America, Olympia Provisions foot-long frankfurter, made with pure pork shoulder and a natural lamb casing, is smoked with hickory and apple wood. Do you love a snappy, old fashioned frankfurter that hangs off the end of the bun? Well, we do too! At some point in the last thirty years, the hot dog has become a bun-fitting, casing-free mockery of what a frankfurter should be. When the folks at Olympia Provisions set out out make their first frankfurter, they wanted to make the frankfurter that they remembered loving as kids. The real O.G. foot-long - with two extra inches of pure meat enjoyment and a casing with a snap! This is guaranteed to be one of the best hot dogs you'll enjoy.

name: Riccio's Hot Calabrian Sausage
description: Riccio's Sausage is made with the highest quality ingredients. They seek to bring you the most authentic and traditional Calabrian flavors by using only the best cuts of prime pork shoulder and absolutely no preservatives. Salsiccia Calabrese, the most popular sausage of Southern Italy, is seasoned with salt, peperoncino picante (Chili pepper), and peperoncino dolce (Sweet Chili pepper). Squeeze them out of the casing and incorporate them into pasta, or throw them directly on the grill and enjoy them with grilled peppers & onions!

name: Baker's Sous-Vide Bacon
description: In 2011, Chef Tony Baker began his mission to recreate the high quality bacon he was accustomed to while growing up in the countryside of England. Unable to find bacon that met his high standards for freshness and ingredients, he founded his own brand. Baker’s Bacon began with a partnership between long time smoke master and bacon expert Steve Sacks at Prime Smoked Meats in Oakland, California. Baker and Sacks worked together for over a year experimenting with cures until they settled on the recipe that is still in use today. With the use of humanely raised heritage pork and a time honored curing technique, Baker’s Bacon delivers sweet and smoky flavors, perfect for your morning breakfast, a BLT, or any other time of day when bacon is required!

name: DeLaurenti Sausage Dust, 1/4 lb
description: Achieve pizza greatness by making sure you have sausage in every bite of your sausage pizza! There's a time for chunks, there's a time for rounds, and there is a time for DUST! Fully cooked and ready to top your pizza Pittsburgh-style, this sausage dust will crisp up in the oven and take your pie to the next level!

name: Despana Traditional Chorizo
tagline: Made with imported Pimenton de la Vera spice
description: Made using a family recipe from Northern Spain, Despaña chorizo incorporates De la Vera paprika, garlic powder, and natural casings to create this classic Spanish pork sausage. Rich and mildly spicy, these are perfect for paella, stews, pasta dishes, or anywhere you want to add smoky-sweet heat and savory pork. Approximately 5 links to a pound.

name: Leoncini Pancetta
description: Imported from Italy, Leoncini's Pancetta is a fully cooked and lightly smoked slab pancetta. Our best selling pancetta, it is perfect for pastas, vegetables, pizza, and wrapping your shrimp. We recommend trimming the rind before use to avoid popping in the pan while you sauté. Although the smoke is subtle, it is definitely present.

name: Levoni Pancetta
description: The Levoni Company has only been making great charcuterie since 1911. Over 100 years and still going strong. When it was essential to fight the harsh climates even with food, to endure physical exertions of manual labor and face daily trips on foot or by bicycle, the fat parts of the pig used to be considered "gold" because they brought a lot of energy. This is how pancetta became a sought-after food... Of course, its deliciousness helped its success on Italian tables quite a bit. Equally at home on a charcuterie board and in sandwiches as it is in recipes, this pancetta has a delicate aroma, characterized by pepper and cloves. The perfect addition to pastas, vegetables, pizza, and wrapping your shrimp.

name: Molinari Coteghino, 14oz
description: Cotechino is originally an Emilian sausage made of pork, lard, pork rind and spices. Because of the pork rind, it was once viewed as peasant food, but it has nevertheless won a place of honor at the table on Christmas and New Year’s Eve. Cotechino di Modena has earned PGI recognition. It is delicious with eggplant, or lentils and it's consumption is closely linked to the New Year’s holiday. It represents abundance and is served for good luck!

name: Smoking Goose Guanciale
tagline: Cured pork jowel with black pepper & coriander
description: From Smoking Goose in Indiana, this guanciale, or pork jowel, is dry-rub-cured with black pepper and coriander before being lightly smoked over apple wood. Perfect for your Carbonara or Bucatini all'Amatriciana, or for any other time you entertain bacon being an option.

name: Smoking Goose Lardo
description: What is Lardo? It is melt-in-your-mouth, cured pork back fat. Seasoned with juniper berries, rosemary, and bay leaf, Smoking Goose's Lardo is delicate in texture and rich in savory flavor, sure to add a new dimension to any dish. Wrap thin slices around melon or grilled shrimp, melt into roasted potatoes, or enjoy it simply on top of warm, grilled bread. All Smoking Goose recipes begin on the farm. They partner with small, family farms in Indiana and neighboring states raising animals as nature intended: no Gestation Pens, Antibiotic Free, 100% Vegetarian Feed, No Growth Promotants.
